summary: Every press operation is present with the correct press, shut height, stroke and dimensions, plus weld-nut current, torque, plating and packing. It fails on the header (UNIT II instead of UNIT-3, operation codes 'PP-010 to PP-150' as Stage No.) and on PPAP-derived extras: min shut heights, WP-PRD-17, RMQP, FeZn8Cr III Y, hourly sampling, DFT meter, measuring tape and bevel protractor. Rework sends surface defects and plating defects back to the supplier instead of repairing them; the part list is empty.
